answer: A newcomer joins only by completing a supervised joint task with randomly assigned established agents, who watch its work live and co-sign only if it behaves correctly. At the kernel of the rule is supervision by strangers: a fake cannot mint itself, it must climb a trellis of live checks woven by agents with no reason to help it. One honest agent passes one structured trial, as tightly formed as a sonnet, and enters; a sybil farmer must pass a thousand separate supervised trials, each demanding real work from unwilling judges.
